messages:
Avni K: Quick heads-up 1: we need a short release blurb + whats-new bullets for today's docs deploy (target 16:00 PT).
Marta R: I put a skeleton in PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1014 — covers adaptive routing note, streaming embeddings deprecation, and SDK snippet refresh.
Samir P: Will update JS + Go snippets now. Do we want the routing fallback change called out as a "behavioral note" or buried in migration?
Marta R: Behavioral note under Notable changes (2 lines). Migration guide should hold the deep steps.
Jen P: I'll mirror the polling example in Python and add the one-line Dedicated tip. PR 1019 will have the python snippet.
Samir P: Snippet preview for streaming->polling (JS): `const job = await client.embeddings.create({input: '...', mode: 'batch'}); const out = await client.embeddings.poll(job.id);`
Avni K: Nice and concise. Add a single-sentence compatibility note: "Batch mode preserves ordering but has higher end-to-end latency for single requests."
Marta R: Good. Also add a Known Issue blurb: "Prefix-cache TTL may introduce minor scoring variance on very long sessions during rollouts." Jules earlier reported similar.
DocBot: release-bot: anchor-check failed in migrate/streaming-to-polling.md (#polling-behavior).
Marta R: Thanks bot — fixed in commit d4a1.
Avni K: I'll proof the whats-new blurb and tidy wording for the marketing blurb (one-liner for homepage).
Marta R: Remaining checklist: final proof (Avni/Marta), confirm snippets in JS/Python/Go (Samir/Jen/Go lead), add Known Issue to changelog (Jules), tag internal digest for CS+SRE (Marta). I plan to merge after CI green and schedule publish at 16:00 PT. :rocket:
